# get_dynamic_function_tool

> Get details of a specific Dynamic Function by ID or name.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `dynamic_functions` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=get_dynamic_function_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Get details of a specific Dynamic Function by ID or name.

This tool retrieves the full details of a single Dynamic Function including:
- Function metadata (name, description, active status)
- Schedule configuration and next run time
- Full JavaScript code
- Configuration settings (excluding OAuth secrets). Any key that looks like a
  secret (api_key, *_token, password, etc.) is stored encrypted and is REMOVED
  from `configuration` entirely, not just its value — `configuration_keys` lists
  every key that was set, secret or not, by name only, so a secret you saved
  doesn't just silently vanish from the response.
- OAuth connection status
- Shared configuration details
- Recent execution history

EXAMPLES:
Get by ID: {id: 123}
Get by name: {name: "sync_contacts"}
Get without executions: {name: "sync_contacts", include_executions: false}
Get with more history: {id: 123, execution_limit: 10}

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | integer | no | Function ID (use id OR name) |
| `name` | string | no | Function name (use id OR name) |
| `include_executions` | boolean | no | Include recent execution history (default: true) |
| `execution_limit` | integer | no | Number of recent executions to include (default: 5, max: 20) |
